text: Tessa said, “I can hang the white sheet.” Mrs Bell said, “I need the peg bag.” Tessa borrowed the peg bag. The wooden prop was slippery. The washing line was low. Tessa said, “I need help.” Mr Osei said, “I can hold the white sheet.” Tessa and Mr Osei carried the white sheet into the rain shelter. Tessa folded the white sheet. Tessa pegged the white sheet. The little sock slipped. Mr Osei caught the little sock. He hung the little sock beside the white sheet. Tessa gave the peg bag to Mrs Bell. The little sock swung gently. The white sheet was clean.
